## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; scientific changes pass the full verification suite.
- [ ] New tolerances have an independent justification.
- [ ] Data and figures were regenerated if their scientific content changed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog match the final change.

## Scientific impact

List affected time scales, boundary conditions, identities, or counting
conventions. Include before/after evidence for changed numerical results.
